(7) A stylized character introduction screen shows the robed figure in a dramatic pose with large text captions flanking him. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional commercial for the mobile game Arena of Valor, specifically highlighting its Chinese New Year 'God's Trial' event and the 'Allain' skin. It leverages the popularity of influencer Snake Ball in a humorous, high-energy skit to build excitement and drive game logins.
